plans.name: Moderato
plans.note: Agent credit values are approximate, based on typical task token consumption. Monthly credits are converted to the equivalent number of tasks for the same feature and are for reference only. Membership features share one credit pool metered by token usage; credits refresh each month. Kimi Code has a separate 5-hour / weekly rate limit, but no numeric limit is stated on this page.
